llm.evidence: High-resolution tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) was performed on a single LTQ Orbitrap Elite instrument (Thermo Scientific)
The dataset also provides protein expression information from two parallel methods of label-free quantification
Proteins were digested on-filter (16 h, 37 °C) with sequencing-grade modified trypsin (50:1, Promega)
the samples were reduced (70 °C, 5 min) with dithiothreitol (3 mM)
alkylated in the dark (ambient temperature, 30 min) with iodoacetamide (9 mM)
